title: Welcome page uses the app's own background
items: The watermark M and probability curve are gone.

The Welcome page now sits on the same background treatment as the app itself: its dark base, soft green and blue corner glows and a faint field tint, held steady from the top of the page to the footer.
The header and the three Explore cards use the app's own top-strip and card surfaces, so entering Matchday feels like continuing on the same screen.
